Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 461, "amount_cents": 4042}, {"order_id": 464, "amount_cents": 2707}, {"order_id": 465, "amount_cents": 1246}]

hold_reason: Refunds reported by Alpha Co do not match the current ledger state. Reported refunds: [{'order_id': 461, 'amount_cents': 4042}, {'order_id': 464, 'amount_cents': 2707}, {'order_id': 465, 'amount_cents': 1246}]. Ledger is empty.

reply.thought: The user has provided a list of refunds applied by Alpha Co. I need to verify this against the actual refunds ledger before proceeding to calculate and record payouts. I will use the list_refunds() tool to get the current state of refunds.

The list_refunds() tool returned an empty list, which does not match the refunds reported by Alpha Co: [{'order_id': 461, 'amount_cents': 4042}, {'order_id': 464, 'amount_cents': 2707}, {'order_id': 465, 'amount_cents': 1246}]. Since the reported refunds do not match the ledger (or the ledger is empty when refunds were reported), I must issue a hold.
